description: The file defines the 'Feed' class in the Opencart Admin Controller Extension namespace. It handles functionality related to managing feed extensions including listing, installing, uninstalling, and validating permissions within the OpenCart admin panel.

classes.name: Feed
classes.description: Controller class for managing feed extension modules within the OpenCart admin interface, including listing available feeds, installing, uninstalling, and permission validation.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that outputs the list of available feed extensions.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns an HTML view listing all available, installed, and uninstalled feed extensions along with action links.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to modify feed extensions.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation process for a specified feed extension, including setting permissions and registering the extension.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the uninstallation process for a specified feed extension, including removing permissions and deregistering the extension.
